notes.title: New Skyhill update with super secret ending
notes.content:
Today, the iOS Mobile version of Skyhill has been released that features a new ending to beat. For iPad 4 and iPhone 5 or higher. (Android is planned, too!) 

However, you PC, Mac and Linux players should enjoy this super ending, too! Therefore, the STEAM version has received an update with these changes: 

[list]
[*]Additional super secret ending based on a fan idea
[*]Cloudsaving
[*]Turkish text translation
[*]Optimized graphics
[*]Optimized performance
[*]Redesigned main menu
[*]Bugfixes
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Livestream Mode and new update available!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

SKYHILL gets its own Livestream Mode on twitch. The new Livestream Mode lets players directly connect to Twitch via the in-game menu, enabling game control via Twitch chat. This way, viewers can influence the game and play together with the streamer.

The new update also fixes some bugs and problems:

Patch Notes 1.0.20:

•	Livestream mode added
•	Some Korean and Japanese texts fixed
•	Enemy with gun fixed
•	Sound for empty loot deleted
•	HP bonus on getting level adjusted
•	Total Mess perk changed. You’ll now lose each 8th item (was each 10th)
•	New Life + Extremist exploit fixed 
•	Music volume for perk Retro Cinema fixed
•	Bug with fruit and veg recipes fixed
•	Achievement for 60+ damage fixed
•	Description for perk “Addict” changed
•	Problem with two enemies in one room and their avatars when one ran away fixed
•	Small bug with bird from window fixed
•	Hotkey “ESC” for full screen quests added
•	Perk “Amnesia” changed from 50th floor to random floor
•	Russian journal texts updated and proofread
•	 Perk “Amnesia” can no longer be used while walking
•	Problem when clicking a room while lift is opening fixed
•	Feature added: When you discard a weapon you’ll get a random component
•	Some crafting bugs fixed 
•	Bug with enemy who runs away on the first floors fixed
•	Programmator, battery and keycards for recording removed 
•	Recipe for Key added
•	Easy mode locked if you did not die at least one time
•	And some more small bugs and fixes

Have a great weekend and keep dying!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hi guys,

the second hotfix is online now:

- Some problems with Chinese, Japanese, Korean texts fixed 
- The problems of female mutants should now be fixed
- The recently infected mutant no longer has an invisible gun. It's visible now and still deadly.
- Fixed some German text issues
- You will now earn perks after completing the game
- Note #52 has been fixed
- Also, we fixed several minor issues

Have a great weekend!

notes.content:

- Fixed several UI and text display issues of the Chinese, Japanese and Korean texts

Have fun playing and dying!
